scenes.say: Can't afford a house anyway, so why save? That thought is the trap.
When the goal looks impossible, people stop saving, or bet it all on one big swing.
The swing usually misses. And the miss proves the story: trying is pointless.
Hopelessness makes you choose exactly the decisions that make the future worse.
The way out isn't a bigger goal. It's a smaller one you can hit in three months.
scenes.show: A goal you hit in three months.

scenes.say: Nihilism feels like honesty. It's just giving up with better branding.
